experiment.name: layer8_lora_puzzle_smoke
experiment.hypothesis: LoRA on Supa-A1.1 layer 8 alone (strongest null under identity-skip) can raise puzzle val exact and make L8 skip more catastrophic.
experiment.non_claim: Inference leave-one-out redundancy is not training importance. No efficacy claim until dual metrics move and an all-layer control exists.

caveat: Inference leave-one-out sensitivity is not training importance. No all-layer matched-budget control in this smoke.
